fullPassage: Did you know that many technologies around us originated from space technology? You may not have realized it, but we have been enjoying the enormous benefits of space technology in our daily lives for a long time. Let's see how some examples of it have been invented and integrated into our daily lives already. Memory foam was initially developed to minimize the effects of the force of gravity on astronauts during takeoff and landing. Memory foam absorbs shock by changing its shape in reaction to pressure, and it can change its shape to match the body shape of an astronaut. Once the pressure is lifted, memory foam gradually returns to its original shape, as if it remembered its original form. Because of this characteristic, it is called "memory" foam. It provides astronauts with improved protection and comfort when they are in their seats. Since memory foam was first introduced into the public domain, it has been used in a number of products such as beds and sofas. Today's water purifier also originated from space technology. While planning their human space exploration program, NASA scientists realized that it was impossible to load a sufficient amount of clean water into a spacecraft. Then, they hit upon an idea that wastewater could be recycled once harmful bacteria were removed. So they developed a water purification system that could successfully kill off bacteria. Continued research led to the invention of a better water purification system that uses cartridges for longer missions that did not need to be replaced frequently. This water purifying technique was developed for several decades and then marketed for domestic use. Another everyday item developed from space technology is the air purifier. A reliable source of food was vital for survival in space. In order to get fresh food, astronauts had to cultivate crops in the spacecraft. However, there was a major obstacle. When plants grow, ethylene gas is produced. It accelerates the aging of plants and the decaying of fruits. Since it was impossible to exchange gas for clean air while in space, scientists developed an air purification system to remove the gas. Although the goal was to eliminate ethylene, the system could get rid of other unwanted things from the air, too. A private company recognized the potential of the air purification system and obtained a license to develop and commercialize it. The fourth invention is the wireless headset. It was devised after an unexpected incident NASA had experienced. The second manned spacecraft launched by the U.S. completed its mission and successfully landed in the Atlantic Ocean. The command pilot was waiting for the recovery team that would get him and the capsule from the ocean. Everything was going smoothly until unexpectedly, the capsule started to leak. Water flooded into the cabin before the team arrived, and the pilot had to escape, abandoning all of the spacecraft's radio communications equipment. This prevented him from communicating with the recovery team. He was left floating in the ocean until he succeeded in visibly getting the rescue helicopter's attention. After this accident, NASA and a partner company developed helmets equipped with a radio system that could communicate with a designated base station. Later, wireless headsets using this system were introduced to the world. These days, Bluetooth technology has been incorporated into wireless headsets. Now we can connect headsets wirelessly with mobile digital devices such as smartphones and laptops. In our daily lives, there are many other inventions that have their origins in space technology including the smartphone camera and the computer mouse. Private firms as well as government organizations have invested heavily in space technology for space exploration. Therefore, we can expect that our future lives will be significantly influenced by space technology that has not yet been invented.

✅ ① everyday inventions that originated from space technology(우주 기술에서 비롯된 일상 발명품들): 메모리폼·정수기·공기 청정기·무선 헤드셋 등 우주 기술에서 나온 일상용품을 다루는 글 전체를 아우름 ← 정답

❌ ② the military history of unmanned drones(무인 드론의 군사 역사): 본문 주제가 아님

❌ ③ how to become a professional astronaut(우주비행사가 되는 법): 본문에 없는 내용

❌ ④ the dangers of using too much technology at home(가정에서 기술을 너무 많이 쓰는 위험): 글의 논지와 무관
det.tip: 메모리폼·정수기·공기청정기·무선헤드셋을 관통 = 우주 기술에서 비롯된 일상 발명품

questions.passage: Did you know that many technologies around us originated from space technology? You may not have realized it, but we have been enjoying the enormous benefits of space technology in our daily lives for a long time. Let's see how some examples of it have been invented and integrated into our daily lives already. Memory foam was initially developed to minimize the effects of the force of gravity on astronauts during takeoff and landing. Memory foam absorbs shock by changing its shape in reaction to pressure, and it can change its shape to match the body shape of an astronaut. Once the pressure is lifted, memory foam gradually returns to its original shape, as if it remembered its original form. Because of this characteristic, it is called "memory" foam. It provides astronauts with improved protection and comfort when they are in their seats.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 제목으로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: ② From Space to Home: Technologies in Our Daily Lives(우주에서 가정으로: 일상 속 기술)
det.analysis:
글은 우주 기술에서 비롯되어 일상생활에 쓰이게 된 여러 발명품을 설명해요.

❌ ① Space Travel: A Dream Beyond Our Reach(우주여행: 닿을 수 없는 꿈): 본문은 우주여행 자체가 아니라 그 기술의 일상 활용을 다뤄요.

✅ ② From Space to Home: Technologies in Our Daily Lives(우주에서 가정으로: 일상 속 기술): 우주 기술이 일상 제품으로 이어진다는 글 전체를 압축한 제목이에요 ←정답

❌ ③ Why Astronauts Prefer Memory Foam Beds(우주비행사가 메모리폼 침대를 선호하는 이유): 메모리폼은 여러 예시 중 하나일 뿐이에요.

❌ ④ The End of Private Space Exploration(민간 우주 탐사의 종말): 본문은 오히려 민간 기업의 투자를 언급해요.
det.tip: 핵심 메시지 = 우주 기술이 일상 제품으로(From Space to Home)

ch: Space Travel: A Dream Beyond Our Reach
From Space to Home: Technologies in Our Daily Lives
Why Astronauts Prefer Memory Foam Beds
The End of Private Space Exploration

questions.passage: Today's water purifier also originated from space technology. While planning their human space exploration program, NASA scientists realized that it was impossible to load a sufficient amount of clean water into a spacecraft. Then, they <u>hit upon an idea</u> that wastewater could be recycled once harmful bacteria were removed. So they developed a water purification system that could successfully kill off bacteria. Continued research led to the invention of a better water purification system that uses cartridges for longer missions that did not need to be replaced frequently.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 hit upon an idea가 의미하는 바로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: ③ 문득 어떤 아이디어를 떠올렸다
det.analysis:
밑줄 'hit upon an idea'의 hit upon은 '우연히·문득 ~을 생각해내다'라는 뜻의 표현이에요. 'Then, they hit upon an idea that wastewater could be recycled'는 폐수를 재활용할 수 있다는 아이디어를 '문득 떠올렸다'는 의미예요.

❌ ① 포기한 것이 아니라 새로 떠올린 것이에요.

❌ ② 반대한 것이 아니라 생각해낸 것이에요.

✅ ③ 문득 아이디어를 떠올렸다는 뜻이에요 ←정답

❌ ④ 실행에 옮긴 것은 그 다음 단계(developed a system)예요.
det.tip: hit upon = 우연히·문득 ~을 생각해내다

ch: 오랜 계획 끝에 결국 그 아이디어를 포기했다
그 아이디어에 대해 강하게 반대 의견을 냈다

questions.passage: The command pilot was waiting for the recovery team that would get him and the capsule from the ocean. Everything was going smoothly until unexpectedly, the capsule started to leak. Water flooded into the cabin before the team arrived, and the pilot had to escape, abandoning all of the spacecraft's radio communications equipment. This prevented him from communicating with the recovery team. <u>He</u> was left floating in the ocean until he succeeded in visibly getting the rescue helicopter's attention. After this accident, NASA and a partner company developed helmets equipped with a radio system that could communicate with a designated base station. Later, wireless headsets using this system were introduced to the world.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 He가 가리키는 대상으로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: ④ 지휘 조종사(the command pilot)
det.analysis:
밑줄 문장 'He was left floating in the ocean until he succeeded in visibly getting the rescue helicopter's attention'의 He는, 앞에서 캡슐에서 탈출해 바다에 떠 있게 된 사람을 가리켜요. 'The command pilot was waiting for the recovery team ~'과 'the pilot had to escape'로 이어진 바로 그 '지휘 조종사'예요.

❌ ① the recovery team(회수팀)은 복수이고 He가 기다리던 대상이에요.

❌ ② 두 번째 유인 우주선은 사물이에요.

❌ ③ 구조 헬리콥터는 He가 주의를 끌려던 대상이에요.

✅ ④ 지휘 조종사(the command pilot)가 바다에 떠 있던 그 사람이에요 ←정답
det.tip: The command pilot → the pilot → He로 이어집니다.

questions.passage: These days, Bluetooth technology has been incorporated into wireless headsets. Now we can connect headsets wirelessly with mobile digital devices such as smartphones and laptops. In our daily lives, there are many other inventions that have their origins in space technology including __________. Private firms as well as government organizations have invested heavily in space technology for space exploration.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 빈칸에 the smartphone camera and the computer mouse(스마트폰 카메라와 컴퓨터 마우스)가 적절
det.analysis:
✅ ① the smartphone camera and the computer mouse(스마트폰 카메라와 컴퓨터 마우스): 'many other inventions that have their origins in space technology including ___'에서 우주 기술에 기원을 둔 '일상 발명품'의 예로, 스마트폰 카메라와 컴퓨터 마우스가 적절 ← 정답
❌ ② the rocket engine and the space suit(로켓 엔진과 우주복): 일상용품이 아니라 우주 장비 자체라 문맥과 어긋남
❌ ③ the microscope and the telescope(현미경과 망원경): 본문에 없는 예시
❌ ④ the solar panel and the wind turbine(태양광 패널과 풍력 터빈): 본문에 없는 예시
det.tip: 일상 속 우주 기술 발명품의 예 → 스마트폰 카메라와 컴퓨터 마우스

ch: the smartphone camera and the computer mouse
the rocket engine and the space suit
the solar panel and the wind turbine

questions.passage: Another everyday item developed from space technology is the air purifier. A reliable source of food was vital for survival in space. In order to get fresh food, astronauts had to cultivate crops in the spacecraft. __________. When plants grow, ethylene gas is produced. It accelerates the aging of plants and the decaying of fruits.
questions.stem:
다음 우리말 뜻에 맞도록 주어진 단어를 모두 배열하여 문장을 완성하시오.

"하지만 중대한 장애물이 하나 있었다." (6단어) (영어로) [조건] (1) a, however, major, obstacle, there, was 를 모두 사용 (2) 정확히 6단어로 쓸 것

det.korean: However there was a major obstacle
det.analysis:
'하지만'은 문두의 However로 시작해요: However.

'~이 있었다'는 'there was + 단수 명사'의 유도부사 there 구문이에요: there + was.

'중대한 장애물 하나'는 a major obstacle이에요: a + major + obstacle.

순서대로 이으면 However / there / was / a / major / obstacle.
det.tip: there was + 단수 명사(~이 있었다): there was a major obstacle

questions.wa: However there was a major obstacle
accept: However there was a major obstacle

questions.passage: Did you know that many technologies around us originated from space technology? You may not have realized it, but we have been __________ (enjoy) the enormous benefits of space technology in our daily lives for a long time.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 흐름에 맞도록 괄호 안에 주어진 단어를 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 쓰시오. (1단어, 영어로)

det.korean: enjoying (현재완료진행형).
det.analysis: 구문 분석: 'we have been ___ the enormous benefits'에서 앞에 'have been'이 있으므로 'have been + -ing'의 현재완료진행형이에요. 과거부터 지금까지 '계속 누려오고 있다'는 의미이므로 enjoy를 enjoying으로 바꿔야 해요. 'have been enjoying(누려오고 있다)'으로 해석돼요.
det.tip: have been + -ing(현재완료진행) → have been enjoying

questions.passage: Today's water purifier also originated from space technology. While planning their human space exploration program, NASA scientists realized that __________ into a spacecraft. Then, they hit upon an idea that wastewater could be recycled once harmful bacteria were removed. So they developed a water purification system that could successfully kill off bacteria. Continued research led to the invention of a better water purification system that uses cartridges for longer missions that did not need to be replaced frequently.
questions.stem:
다음 우리말 뜻에 맞도록 주어진 단어를 모두 배열하여 문장을 완성하시오.

"충분한 양의 깨끗한 물을 싣는 것은 불가능했다." (11단어) (영어로) [조건] (1) a, amount, clean, impossible, it, load, of, sufficient, to, was, water 를 모두 사용 (2) 정확히 11단어로 쓸 것 (가주어 It 활용)

det.korean: It was impossible to load a sufficient amount of clean water
det.analysis:
'~하는 것은 …했다'는 가주어 It을 문두에 두고 진주어 to부정사를 뒤로 보내요: It + was + impossible.

진주어는 '싣는 것'으로 to load예요: to + load.

무엇을 싣는가 하면 '충분한 양의 깨끗한 물'이에요: a + sufficient + amount + of + clean + water.

순서대로 이으면 It / was / impossible / to / load / a / sufficient / amount / of / clean / water.
det.tip: 가주어 It ~ 진주어 to부정사: It was impossible to load ~

questions.wa: It was impossible to load a sufficient amount of clean water
accept: It was impossible to load a sufficient amount of clean water

questions.passage: After this accident, NASA and a partner company developed helmets equipped with a radio system that could communicate with a designated base station. Later, __________. These days, Bluetooth technology has been incorporated into wireless headsets.
questions.stem:
다음 우리말에 맞도록 주어진 단어를 올바른 순서로 배열하시오.
"이 시스템을 사용하는 무선 헤드셋이 세상에 소개되었다."

[ headsets / introduced / system / the / this / to / using / were / Wireless / world ] (10단어) (영어로)

det.korean: Wireless headsets using this system were introduced to the world
det.analysis:
주어는 '이 시스템을 사용하는 무선 헤드셋'이에요. '~을 사용하는'은 현재분사 using이 명사를 뒤에서 꾸며요: Wireless + headsets + using + this + system.

'세상에 소개되었다'는 수동태로, '소개된' 것이라 'were + 과거분사'예요: were + introduced + to + the + world.

순서대로 이으면 Wireless / headsets / using / this / system / were / introduced / to / the / world.
det.tip: 분사 using(~을 사용하는) + 수동태 were introduced(소개되었다)

questions.wa: Wireless headsets using this system were introduced to the world
accept: Wireless headsets using this system were introduced to the world

questions.passage: Later, wireless headsets using this system were introduced to the world. These days, __________. Now we can connect headsets wirelessly with mobile digital devices such as smartphones and laptops.
questions.stem:
다음 우리말 뜻에 맞도록 주어진 단어를 모두 배열하여 문장을 완성하시오.

"블루투스 기술이 무선 헤드셋에 통합되었다." (8단어) (영어로) [조건] (1) been, Bluetooth, has, headsets, incorporated, into, technology, wireless 를 모두 사용 (2) 정확히 8단어로 쓸 것 (현재완료 수동태 활용)

det.korean: Bluetooth technology has been incorporated into wireless headsets
det.analysis:
주어는 '블루투스 기술'이에요: Bluetooth + technology.

'통합되었다'는 현재완료 수동태로, 'has been + 과거분사'예요: has + been + incorporated.

'무선 헤드셋에'는 into wireless headsets로 이어요: into + wireless + headsets.

순서대로 이으면 Bluetooth / technology / has / been / incorporated / into / wireless / headsets.
det.tip: 현재완료 수동태 has been + 과거분사: has been incorporated

questions.wa: Bluetooth technology has been incorporated into wireless headsets
accept: Bluetooth technology has been incorporated into wireless headsets
